verdict.rationale: Gitea exposes an API for custom workflows and offers user permission management and access control lists. It also supports OAuth2 and can act as an OIDC provider. Together these suggest an agent could get restricted access, for example through a dedicated low-privilege account, but nothing describes issuing API tokens with explicit scopes. Missing for 10: documented scoped/fine-grained personal access tokens, per-token permission or repo restriction, token expiry and revocation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, and hands-on corroboration.
